Senior Backend Engineer

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build and scale our
AI-powered platform.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python and FastAPI for building production REST APIs
- Experience building LLM-powered features with LangChain or similar frameworks
- Hands-on experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes
- Experience with AWS (ECS, Lambda, or EKS)
- Solid understanding of PostgreSQL and relational data modeling
- Comfortable writing automated tests (pytest) and working in an agile team

Nice to have:
- Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines
- Prior experience in an early-stage startup environment

This role involves owning services end-to-end: designing APIs, deploying
to a Kubernetes cluster on AWS, and iterating quickly with the team.
